dialogues.en: "Yeah, yeah......"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, yeah......"

dialogues.jp: 「はいはい……」
dialogues.en: I murmured to myself and stretched towards the alarm clock.
dialogues.text: I murmured to myself and stretched towards the alarm clock.

dialogues.jp: 呟きながら、目覚ましに手を伸ばす。

dialogues.en: "Phew...... okay."
dialogues.text: "Phew...... okay."

dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……よっと」
dialogues.en: I got up without any snoozing.
dialogues.text: I got up without any snoozing.

dialogues.jp:
２、３分だれるでもなく、すんなりと起き上が
る。
dialogues.en: "I feel refreshed today."
dialogues.text: "I feel refreshed today."

dialogues.jp: 「今日はなんだか目覚めがいいな」
dialogues.en: I got out of bed quickly and got dressed.
dialogues.text: I got out of bed quickly and got dressed.

dialogues.jp:
ベッド脇の階段を軽快に下り、パジャマを脱ぎ
捨て制服に身を包む。
dialogues.en: "Alright."
dialogues.text: "Alright."

dialogues.jp: 「よし」
dialogues.en: I grabbed my bag and put my hand on the door knob.
dialogues.text: I grabbed my bag and put my hand on the door knob.

dialogues.jp: 鞄を手に提げ、ドアノブに手をかける。
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en:
I was expecting to see Nemu in the living room, but she
wasn't there.
dialogues.text:
I was expecting to see Nemu in the living room, but she
wasn't there.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の挨拶で迎えられると思っていた居間には、
誰もいなかった。
dialogues.en: "Did I get up earlier than her?"
dialogues.text: "Did I get up earlier than her?"

dialogues.jp: 「珍しく俺のほうが早く起きたのか」
dialogues.en:
I put my bag down on the sofa, and set a slice of bread into
the toaster.
dialogues.text:
I put my bag down on the sofa, and set a slice of bread into
the toaster.

dialogues.jp:
鞄をソファーに置きトースターに食パンをセッ
トする。
dialogues.en: "Let's go wake Nemu up while I wait for my toast."
dialogues.text: "Let's go wake Nemu up while I wait for my toast."

dialogues.jp:
「せっかくだから、待っている間に音夢を起こ
　しに行くか」
dialogues.en: Waking up earlier than Nemu doesn't happen very often.
dialogues.text: Waking up earlier than Nemu doesn't happen very often.

dialogues.jp:
音夢を起こせるなんて、一生のうちにそう何度
もないだろうからな。
dialogues.en: I went back upstairs and headed to Nemu's room.
dialogues.text: I went back upstairs and headed to Nemu's room.

dialogues.jp:
トースターのそばを離れ、階段を上って音夢の
部屋を目指す。
dialogues.en: Knock knock.
dialogues.text: Knock knock.

dialogues.jp: コンコン――
dialogues.en: "Nemu, are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu, are you awake?"

dialogues.jp: 「音夢、起きてるか？」
dialogues.en: I copied what Nemu usually says and turned the door knob.
dialogues.text: I copied what Nemu usually says and turned the door knob.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の真似をして、ドアのノブを回す。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: Hmmm......
dialogues.text: Hmmm......

dialogues.jp: ふむ……。
dialogues.en: This must happen... sometimes.
dialogues.text: This must happen... sometimes.

dialogues.jp: ときどきあるよな。こういうの。
dialogues.en:
It's natural for this to happen sometimes when we're living
under the same roof.
dialogues.text:
It's natural for this to happen sometimes when we're living
under the same roof.

dialogues.jp:
同じ屋根の下で暮らしていれば、至極当然の出
来事だろう。
dialogues.en: "You're awake. Good morning."
dialogues.text: "You're awake. Good morning."

dialogues.jp: 「起きてたんだな。おはよう音夢」
dialogues.en: I pretended that nothing special had happened.
dialogues.text: I pretended that nothing special had happened.

dialogues.jp: あくまでも日常の朝として振る舞う。
dialogues.en: "Good morning, niisan. You're up early today."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, niisan. You're up early today."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう兄さん。今朝は早いですね」
dialogues.en:
She didn't seem to be upset -- she responded in a very
family-like way.
dialogues.text:
She didn't seem to be upset -- she responded in a very
family-like way.

dialogues.jp:
慣れの領域というか――典型的な反応ではなく、
家族ゆえの落ち着いた反応を返してくれる。
dialogues.en: "I woke up no problem today."
dialogues.text: "I woke up no problem today."

dialogues.jp: 「今日は素直に起きれたからな」
dialogues.en:
"Is that so? It would be helpful if you could do that every
day."
dialogues.text:
"Is that so? It would be helpful if you could do that every
day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか。いつもそうだと助かるんで
　すけど」
dialogues.en: She was talking with a smile.
dialogues.text: She was talking with a smile.

dialogues.jp: にこやかな音夢の口調が、耳に届く。
dialogues.en: "By the way, niisan, where are you looking?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, niisan, where are you looking?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ところで兄さん。どちらを見ながらお話して
　いらっしゃるんですか？」
dialogues.en: At thick thighs.
dialogues.text: At thick thighs.

dialogues.jp: ふともも。
dialogues.en: I answered her question instantly in my head -- @
dialogues.text: I answered her question instantly in my head -- @

dialogues.jp:
即座に頭の中でそう答えていた自分に――敬意を
感じる。
dialogues.en: and I was proud of my answer.
dialogues.text: and I was proud of my answer.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「話をするときは、相手の顔を見ませんと」
dialogues.en:
"You know, you should look at the other person's face when
you talk with someone."
dialogues.text:
"You know, you should look at the other person's face when
you talk with someone."

dialogues.jp: （――って、怒り最頂点！？）
dialogues.en: (......She seems very angry now!?)
dialogues.text: (......She seems very angry now!?)

dialogues.jp: 「その、なんだ……いい天気ですね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, umm...... it's a nice day, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, umm...... it's a nice day, isn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
なぜ、人は焦ると天気のことを口にするのだろ
うか？
dialogues.en: Why do people talk about weather when they're nervous?
dialogues.text: Why do people talk about weather when they're nervous?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it is."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it is."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「身体の具合は大丈夫でしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "How are you feeling?"
dialogues.text: "How are you feeling?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。おかげさまで力がみなぎってますから」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine. Thank you for asking."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine. Thank you for asking."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ところで……いつまで女の子の着替えをご覧
　になっているつもりですか？」
dialogues.en:
"So...... how long are you going to watch a girl get
dressed?"
dialogues.text:
"So...... how long are you going to watch a girl get
dressed?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「恥ずかしいんだから、さっさと出て行きなさ〜
　い！！」
dialogues.en: "You're embarrassing me, get out of my room!!"
dialogues.text: "You're embarrassing me, get out of my room!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だったら追ってくるな〜！」
dialogues.en: "Don't chase me then!"
dialogues.text: "Don't chase me then!"

dialogues.jp:
ベッドに転がっていたぬいぐるみで頭をボスボ
スと叩かれながら、廊下へと退散する。
dialogues.en:
I ran out of her room, being chased by her as she hit my
head with her stuffed animals.
dialogues.text:
I ran out of her room, being chased by her as she hit my
head with her stuffed animals.

dialogues.jp: 居間に戻ると、トーストが黒くなっていた……。
dialogues.en:
My toast was all burnt when I returned to the living
room......
dialogues.text:
My toast was all burnt when I returned to the living
room......

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢より早起きしたら…◆
dialogues.en: ◆Waking up earlier than Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Waking up earlier than Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
珍しく早起きしてしまった俺は、音夢を起こし
てやる事にした。貴重な体験ではあるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I got up earlier than Nemu, so decided to go wake her. This
doesn't happen often.
dialogues.text:
I got up earlier than Nemu, so decided to go wake her. This
doesn't happen often.

dialogues.en: This rarely happens, really.
dialogues.text: This rarely happens, really.

dialogues.jp: 貴重すぎるぞ、おい。
